name: Kunstformen
line: A print room for Haeckel's Kunstformen der Natur: the symmetrical desmid plate hangs centred in a wide passe-partout above a Gloock headline, and each explorer is paired with a framed plate; the signature is a glass loupe resting on the jellyfish plate over figure 3 that magnifies it more and more as you scroll (kit --p).
notes: Each scan is cropped in CSS to its printed plate (running head, ruled frame and title kept; the book margins and gutter shadow removed) so the mat sits cleanly around it. Ochre #B08A3E appears only as the loupe's hairline rim (it fails AA for text). The loupe uses the 2000px scan and kit.js data-progress; without JavaScript it rests at a middle magnification. The game screenshots sit in small mats, slightly desaturated, full colour on hover. Gloock has a single weight and no italic (font-synthesis is off) and only the Cyrillic-extended subset, so a Russian page would need a display fallback; Source Sans 3 covers Cyrillic.
